reviews.text: Lane went above and beyond what was expected to correct a bad Rinnai tankless water heater install from another plumber. He quickly indentified the problem and helped us quickly get hot water working again. He worked with Rinnai to get our warranty reinstated on a stuck gas valve. He always called ahead to let us know he was coming and always arrived at the appointed time. Lane even called us on his day off to check to see if we had hot water during the weekend. Lane was courteous and profession

Lane did a great job with a large plumbing issue all the way to the main.  He found issues that another plumber did not find.
Thank you, Horizon, for being thorough!

I had a troubling experience with this company due to one of their drivers. The individual was driving aggressively and recklessly in a marked company vehicle—speeding, weaving through traffic, and showing a complete disregard for safety. It's deeply concerning when a business allows its representatives to behave so irresponsibly on the road. If this is any reflection of the company's overall professionalism, I would strongly reconsider trusting them with a service in my home.

First, I have done business with Horizon for many years, and previously was more than satisfied with the work, but recently I had an interaction that completely ruined their reputation with me.. I called on a Monday and they said they  couldn't get to me until Tuesday of the next week. Come Tuesday. at nearly 5, I called to check on if the plumber was still coming. Then the dispatcher told me that no one would be coming because they didn't do that kind of work. She said that someone had called t

Lane Copeland at Horizon plumbing has done absolutely terrific work for me on two occasions. I recommend him with no reservations. He analyzed and fixed a problem that four other plumbers didn’t have a clue about. I have a new plumber

I needed water filter replaced, supports added and pex tubing properly routed.
Lane and his assistant are well-trained, competent professionals. I’m very satisfied with their work. An additional bonus their final cost was $300 less than competitors
Without reservation I would recommend Horizon plumbing.

We had use Horizon plumb 2 times now, both times they have been wonderful, issues fixed in a timely manner. Great service starts a the moment they answer the phone, their receptionist is very professional and kind. Couple of days ago, plumber Nikk Salas arrived to fix my shower that was leaking, Nikk is very professional and knows his business, immediately new what was wrong and fixed my problem, he had all the parts needed to fix my leak in his van, he showed me the defective part he removed an

Called to request an appointment (company was recommended from home builder), service department was busy and took my contact info for a callback.

They never called back.

Incident 1: I had all my toilets backed up, my kitchen sink had a gargling noise. The plumber came by and told me there was a circular plate in the pipes and they’ve flushed it out. Two days later the issue came back the circular plate was still there which was trapping the toilet paper and backing up, I called in to schedule an emergency as my toilets were backing up. The lady on the call spoke rudely and told me I was using a lot of toilet paper and that was the reason for my issue. The servic

Worst service!

Called them on Sunday, the guy who called back after hearing the water gushing thru one of the bathroom to the first floor, he started joking and laughing!!!!

I don’t know why any new builders uses these guys

Unacceptable service

My technician, Brandon was FANTASTIC!! He called ahead to confirm my service and even shared how far out he was and his ETA. Once he arrived he clearly explained my service and what I would need to ensure proper operation! Not to mention, he completed all of the projects in a timely manner AND, HE CLEANED UP BEHIND HIMSELF!! That may not be a big deal to some but it was a huge deal for us!!

Over and above what I've already shared, Brandon was simply very pleasant!! No one wants a service call b

Contacted over the weekend and they returned my call quickly and were kind and helpful on the phone on Monday morning. I was able to get on the schedule for Wednesday morning and took the morning off to be able to meet the plumber. I called in to check the status an hour after the window they gave me for the appointment and was informed that they called and left a voicemail to reschedule. I checked my phone logs, 0 missed calls and 0 voicemails left. The lady on the phone was very sweet, but men
Great company, very punctual and professional. David helped us out at a time in need and got us taken care of no problem. Would highly recommend and will be going back for any of my plumbing needs.

* This is an amendment to my original review. I erased any negative part of it because they 100% fixed all the issues that we had and did a superb job doing so.*
We had a leak with the water heater that they did a GREAT JOB of fixing, honestly, couldn't be more satisfied with the work!  They were on time, professional, courteous and the total bill was exactly what they quoted me. I waited a few days to post a review because I wanted to make sure the repair held...and it did!  Now, later that sam

I called Horizon to replace an outdoor water faucet.  Lane, our technician was very prompt and courteous.  There were complications in removing the faucet but he stayed diligent in his attempts and eventual success.

i am giving this company a 5 star review solely based on the professionalism, honesty and overall outcome received by their plumbers over the past couple of years. I’m a local realtor, so it’s important for me to have a good database of service providers to refer out to my clients when the need arises. I’ve   had to leverage horizon plumbing services  not just for my personal home, but for my clients homes as well. My most recent experience was with a plumber named Cody. Cody was on time, called
reviews.reviewer_name: Ann Hayle, Realtor Specializing in New Beginnings

reviews.text: Great company and very professional. The customer service ladies answered my call were friendly and kind. They responded quickly and the technician patiently explained everything to me. I recommend Horizon to everyone.

I've had this brand new house for 18 months.  I've had problems since the very beginning and have a history with the company.  They do contract work for Meritage Home Builders in west Fort Worth.  The toilets stop flushing with no reason why other than the offset flanges being inproperly set.  There are no other stoppage problems in any other drains at all, not sinks, not showers.  Just the two toilets. One of the toilet stops within 48 hours of their service call and the second one within 10 da

Intermittent plumbing problems can be really challenging, and I had banged my head against a wall for months trying to fix an intermittent cold water issue with my tankless before I called in the pros.

I have had excellent experiences with Jose in the past, and now Lane, who are both top notch. Their pricing is fair and they show up on time. I'm sure you can find someone to do it for less, but these guys do not cut corners. I now have proper isolation valves to test and service my system.

In a
Tell whoever was driving truck 2022 on north riverside drive at 3:15 on 8/6/2025 to stop tailgating people 15 mph over the speed limit

In 25 years I haven't been able to find a plumbing service that I would call back to do another repair but I have found one now. Jose did a great job tracking the source of the leak, and fixing the problem.  His communication and professional were fantastic. I will not hesitate to call this company again for my plumbing needs. Jose Castro was my technician.

Want to give a shout out to your plumber, Cody Copeland. We have used him several times, most recently this month.  A couple of weeks ago Cody came out to our home and assessed two faucet leaks, one in the laundry room and one in the master bath sink.  While at our home, he got on the line with the Delta company, maker of the hardware, worked with one of their customer representatives to determine the problem parts and then ordered them  while he was at our home.  Today he came back to install t

We've been in our home about three months now and experienced a back up that prohibited us from using any water in the bathrooms or kitchen. The only option was to use the showers and bathrooms at the local gym until we could get it repaired. In my mind, a true emergency. Anna was able to reschedule some non-emergencies and get Jacob out within 24 hrs. Everything works great and Jacob took the time to explain the cleanouts in the front flower beds to help understand the problem. Horizon will alw

The Service Technician did warranty work for us. He was very knowledgeable and professional, and gave additional effort to address warranty issues I didn’t know I had. He proactively checked each fixture to make  sure they were working properly.  I was very impressed!

Miles and Lane were so great!!!!
They fixed the problem quickly, were super understanding, and made me feel so at ease about the condition of my home after the leak! So glad I used Horizon Plumbing Service!!! Also, the lady who helped me get them over here was nice and helpful.

When you have no hot water in January and guests staying with you, urgent action is needed.  The tankless hot water was not working.  The call was answered promptly, dispatch said a technician would be there and that the technician would call before arriving.  And that is how it went.  Jose called and arrived, diagnosed the issue, explained the possible solutions and then called in to get the correct parts lined up.  I was expecting 2-3 days and they had it completed by the next day.  Very pleas

This is my second time using horizon plumbing. Once again, outstanding experience! Hot water heater pilot light wouldn't stay lit. Replace the thermopile myself, still nothing. The technician Jared came out and changed out the entire thermostat assembly was polite and extremely professional. Highly recommend these guys they are top notch.

Wow, a breath of fresh to deal with this company.  We had an issue on a new build after over a year which Horizon had plumbed, Philip came over (such an amazing professional) and effectively and efficiently  identified a failure major leak.  It was identified to be a warranty issue which Justin and the team dealt with promptly, arranging for the plumbing repair, restoration and drywall repair.  I am truly a promoter for this company.  I know this is glowing but really it was that good!

Jose was very customer-service oriented, did a superior job, called before he arrived & explained the process as he worked. He ensured I understood the warranty & told me to call with any questions.

I would highly recommend using Horizon Plumbing!

I chose Horizon because of their good reviews and turns out they’re greatly deserved. Everyone I dealt with was very friendly and professional. My repair ended up being costly (replaced water main),  but Jared spent all day trying to find a way around it, and showed me every step and every problem. When the repair was made they did it very quickly and professionally. The price I was quoted was the price I paid, and honestly found it very reasonable for the amount of work they put in. I would rec

We are very pleased with the work we just had done regarding a slab leak.  It was located 21 feet from the digging entrance, so there was a lot of dirt removed.  Everything was done orderly and the staff was superb.  They were very respectful and told us everything up front regarding what, when, where and how much.  The leak was located, pipes replaced, and dirt filled back in.  The excavation site doesn't even look like anything happened.  Everything is back in place, and we no longer have wate

Had a small issue with a leak with the plumbing that was installed by them through the builder. Micaela was awesome with getting it taken care of. She dispatched a technician as quick as she could and had them repair it as well as getting the appropriate warranty personnel involved even though that was not her department.

Plumbing issues are the worst to have but having someone like that on your team that understands a consumer and makes it easier to deal with.

Horizon plumbing and their team

My new house's manufacturer had this company do the plumbing. However, the water in kitchen sink started leaking in less than a year of the newly constructed house. It was tough to get hold of them, and they finally fixed it for me. However, within few months, the water started leaking again. My warranty expired by a month, and they refused to come fix it for me although the job done was subpar.
I would not recommend this company.

Horizon Plumbing Service came out to replaced 3 toliet pumps - eliminating the noise of leakage and improving the flow when flushing. Joel was very friendly and professional. He listened and addressed my concerns, ensuring I was satified with the service he provided.Would highly recommend and use again

Thank you Horizon Plumbing! I had to call another company because they were the only ones who could send someone out same day (I called very late in the day) to look for my leak. Their bid to fix it was huge, so I needed a 2nd opinion. You fit me into the schedule, got somebody out, found a better (cheaper!) solution and fixed my leak. You truly are the plumber with integrity. Thank you for taking such good care of us!

Jose did a great job of clearly communicating his estimated time of arrival, the issue and the repair.  Everything went very smoothly.
I highly recommend Horizon Plumbing!

Spoke with a manager, Heather, on the phone. She was so mean and offered NO solutions. My toilet flange was defective and not put on properly. They refused to give me the inspection, refused to come out and look at the toilet, refused to even check my other toilets to see if they were defected. I felt defeated speaking with her because she started yelling at me from the get-go. Their front desk lady was very sweet and polite,  however when the manager got on the phone it was a different story. I

These guys are awesome! They arrived promptly and on time, calling me 30 min. ahead of their arrival. They gave me a quote with a good price and stuck to it. My son threw a computer charger down the toilet and they spent 2 1/2 hours working really hard to get it out so I didn't have to replace the toilet, which is expensive. They even told me that if they couldn't retrieve the charger they would not charge me for taking up the toilet. But they worked hard and got it out! They were super efficien

Horizon fixed a leak in the main water supply between the meter and the house. Jimmy and Chris were friendly, courteous and very professional. We will definitely call Horizon Plumbing for any future plumbing needs. I positively recommend Horizon Plumbing to anyone wanting great work at a very reasonable price.

I discovered a strong odor of gas coming from the garage where the tankless water heater is.  I called and the dispatcher was able to get a tech out within 20 minutes of my call.  The tech quickly determined the problem and replaced the gas supply line immediately.    Thankful and impressed with this company and will definitely recommend them.

Ernie Campos just left my house and I am so thankful to him!  He went above and beyond to take care of me and he was the nicest, most helpful person.  We had a leak in our house (a connector piece connecting the hose bib and the pipe.  He found it, fixed it, and cut an extra area in our sheet rock and pulled the insulation out to ensure there would be no mold growth.   He told me how to air it out and to have insulation and sheet rock replaced when all is dry.  He was full of knowledge and showe

I chose Horizon because they were one of the few companies who could install Rinnai products. I emailed the salesman exactly what I wanted, make and model of the water heater I wanted. They give me a quote and were very vague of what it included, I called and emailed the salesman multiple times and insisted the salesman list the make and model I wanted in the quote and he refused and ensures me that it's all good - Turkey install!  They knew we were replacing an existing water heater that suppli

I have nothing but praise for Horizon Plumbing! They were the plumbing contractor for our new home (built about 5 years ago).  They did an incredibly detailed, quality job with the plumbing, including with putting adequate insulation on pipes within home.  In our neighborhood of about 25 homes, all with Horizon plumbing as the contractor,  all of us avoided any major problems like burst pipes during recent winter weather (even with prolonged power outage and freezing temps for days).  Would high

Horizon plumbing installed the water heater in my new home when the water heater started giving out alarm codes and audible alarms they were contacted to come repair the system under the home’s warranty. They had to come out twice (2 reps each time) and nobody knew what they were looking at, dealing with, etc. Finally they told me they were going to order some parts to replace to see if that fixed the issue… havent heard from them since. Every time i call for an update i get blind transferred to
I had a really great experience with Horizon Plumbing. Our leaking pipe was fixed and  our technician was excellent. The customer service this company provides is wonderful. Highly recommended!

Philip was awesome, on time, and professional. My family owns a plumbing company so it feels strange to call another company for help, but I highly recommend Horizon. They are very friendly and get things scheduled fast.

Blake and his partner were absolutely excellent. They came out to complete a repair, and they were friendly, professional, and courteous. Blake had excellent communication, was considerate, and got the job done. Thanks so much!!

Phillip was courteous, professional and friendly. He quickly addressed the subject issue and then checked a few other things for us. We hope not to need a plumber in the future, but when we do, we will request Phillip.

Horizon performed yearly maintenance on our tankless water heaters.  This went well, but the tech accidently stepped thru the ceiling drywall.  The tech said someone would contact me within the next week to schedule a repair.
I waited, but nobody called.  I called them after a couple of weeks, and they said to give it more time.  After numerous more phone calls (and about 2 months time), the drywall was finally repaired, but they didn't schedule anyone to paint it.  The painting still has not be

Very prompt service and reasonable pricing.  I learned about maintenance recommendations for my tankless water heater that I wasn’t ever aware of before. Resolved my issue quickly.  Highly recommend Horizon for all of your plumbing needs.  Thank you.
